permitted_claim: Samples are compared; each sample yields a cell-observation and a gene-observation point cloud.
prohibited_claim: Cells or genes are the independent units of the final clustering outcome.
limitation: Within-sample cells and genes are subsampled technical realizations.

permitted_claim: All finite positive intervals and active levels are retained with separate H0/H1 exact or error-controlled squared-L2 distances.
prohibited_claim: The current method uses only k=1 or a universal 100-point grid.
limitation: Landscape stability does not make raw Rips PH outlier-robust.

permitted_claim: Cell and gene topology provide separate complementary views under fixed coordinate and panel contracts.
prohibited_claim: Dual-view topology or cell/gene topology is unprecedented.
limitation: Gene view uses a fixed transductive global-core panel.

permitted_claim: All six representations selected k=2 by the label-free five-seed stability rule.
prohibited_claim: k=2 recovers the eight tissues or predicts tissue.
limitation: Two clusters are a coarse summary against eight tissues and 18 studies.

permitted_claim: The coarse partitions show modest descriptive tissue and study alignment in the accepted populations.
prohibited_claim: Tissue alignment is independent of study.
limitation: Study and tissue are materially confounded.

permitted_claim: Canonical approach is only a nested descriptive proxy in the full 124 and is non-estimable in the primary 90.
prohibited_claim: Sequencing technology causes the observed topology.
limitation: Six snRNA samples are nested in one tissue and study.

permitted_claim: H1-only distances can produce partitions distinct from H0 despite low H1 contribution to the unweighted composite.
prohibited_claim: H1 features are biological cycles pathways or mechanisms.
limitation: Low energy does not imply H1 is irrelevant; no feature-level biology was validated.

permitted_claim: The unweighted composite is a secondary sensitivity and is usually H0-dominated in this corpus.
prohibited_claim: The composite replaces separate H0 and H1 reporting.
limitation: Unweighted scale makes H0 dominant in this corpus.

permitted_claim: PAM and average linkage can yield materially different partitions and must be shown together.
prohibited_claim: One clustering algorithm is objectively superior from these outcomes.
limitation: Only PAM and average linkage are in the full-124 contract.

permitted_claim: Cell and gene results are reported separately without a global winner.
prohibited_claim: Either cell or gene topology is globally superior.
limitation: Relative view performance changes by study and tissue.

permitted_claim: Equal-weight fusion did not reliably outperform both views under the frozen blocked evaluation.
prohibited_claim: A post-hoc fusion weight is an improved method.
limitation: Only prospectively frozen equal fusion is confirmatory.

permitted_claim: Integration had a corpus-specific negative or null topology increment under the accepted blocked design.
prohibited_claim: Integration generally removes topological noise or generally harms topology.
limitation: Seurat-centered existing corpus; not a comprehensive integration benchmark.

permitted_claim: Primary-90 cell-view conclusions have a completed Euclidean/cosine-chord sensitivity.
prohibited_claim: All cell-view robustness axes and external datasets are covered.
limitation: Sensitivity is limited to the accepted primary-90 cell analysis.

permitted_claim: The fixed 500-gene correlation-chord view is conditional on its transductive panel and metric.
prohibited_claim: The gene view is inductive or insensitive to panel size and distance.
limitation: Panel-size and gene-metric sensitivity require new PH.

permitted_claim: The 124-sample dual-view PH and all-level landscape workflow completed under audited resource and equivalence gates.
limitation: Resource success is hardware and corpus conditional.

permitted_claim: External performance requires a prospectively frozen independent dataset.
prohibited_claim: Performance generalizes to unseen studies tissues methods or assays.
limitation: No independent external analysis has run.
